subject: Draft MAP: Assurance checkpoints & SOC 2 evidence owners (AuraBank)
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@aurabank.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP: Assurance checkpoints & SOC 2 evidence owners (AuraBank)

Hi Jordan — great to chat earlier. Per our discovery, I’m pulling together a brief Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the security review milestone and SOC 2 evidence delivery so your security team can start intake without blockers. Attached is a first-pass MAP workbook and a blank SOC 2 questionnaire we usually use as the intake form.

Proposed high-level milestones (target dates are flexible — please confirm):
- Security questionnaire returned to Redwood (initial pass): 2027-06-17
- Evidence collection (owners assigned): 2027-06-24
- Evidence delivery to AuraBank (secure upload): 2027-07-01
- SOC 2 review complete (security approval / go-ahead): 2027-07-08

Initial owners suggested:
- Redwood intake coordination: Alex Martinez (me)
- Evidence pull (infra/SRE artifacts): Priyom Das
- Control narrative & policy exports: Marissa Cole

Dependencies I noted from our call:
1) AuraBank to confirm list of required artifacts (spreadsheets/PNs) — Jordan/Evelyn
2) Access window to your secure upload bucket (SFTP/S3 presigned link) — AuraBank security
3) Scope confirmation (production only vs prod+staging) — impacts evidence set and timelines

Next steps from our side: I’ll send an editable MAP workbook and a populated questionnaire template (attached). Can you confirm the intake owner on your side and whether the 6/24 collection target is realistic?

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0153
[Attachment: MAP-draft-AuraBank-20270610.xlsx (Excel)]
[Attachment: SOC2-Questionnaire-v1.pdf (PDF)]

From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@aurabank.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evelyn Tran <evelyn.tran@aurabank.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Assurance checkpoints & SOC 2 evidence owners (AuraBank)

Alex — thanks for the clear recap. I’m the security intake owner for this work; Evelyn will coordinate artifact access. A few clarifications from our side:

- We need the completed questionnaire by COB 6/17 so our intake team can triage. If Redwood can answer controls at a high level in that questionnaire (especially around encryption, key management, and data retention), that will speed our review.
- For evidence, we prefer a single S3 share with time-limited credentials. I’ll request one from infra and share the link once it’s ready.
- Scope: we only need production environment artifacts for the initial review. If follow-up is needed for staging, we’ll handle that later.

I’ll circulate an internal checklist to Evelyn and copy you. 6/24 looks OK provided the questionnaire is complete on 6/17.

—Jordan
Jordan Price
Head of Cloud Security, AuraBank
jordan.price@aurabank.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@aurabank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Assurance checkpoints & SOC 2 evidence owners (AuraBank)

Thanks Alex — reviewed the questionnaire and started populating answers for infra artifacts (logs, access lists, AMI IDs). A few notes for Jordan/Evelyn:

- For log retention evidence we can export an S3 bucket listing + sample logs (redacted) and a CloudWatch export (dates: 2027-04-01 to 2027-05-31).
- For key management, we’ll provide the KMS policy export and key rotation schedule. Note: rotation metadata requires access to our KMS audit view — I’ll coordinate with our security admin (Marissa) if additional permissions are needed.
- Expected size of the evidence bundle: ~120MB zipped (mostly logs and pdfs).

I’ve attached a short evidence checklist (section extract) to the MAP workbook so owners can tick items off. If AuraBank prefers a different packaging (per-control folders), say the word and we’ll mirror your structure.

Priyom
Priyom Das
Lead SRE, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: evidence-checklist-excerpt.txt (TXT)]

Alex/Priyom — quick confirmation: our infra team has provisioned a pre-signed S3 share. Link will be sent to the Redwood intake address tomorrow by 9am PT. Questionnaire deadline of 6/17 was tight so we used your answers and added a few follow-up asks; I’ll upload the annotated questionnaire and the internal checklist once I have the S3 link.

We’re aligned on production-only scope. Assuming Redwood delivers the evidence bundle to the S3 share on 7/01, our team will aim to complete the review and return comments by 7/08. If anything changes I’ll flag it early.

Thanks — Jordan
